note: schema_type! keeps the source wire format: partial fields with serde with / serialize_with / deserialize_with go through generated Option adapters instead of dropping the codec, a container tag keeps the source tag value (the DTO gets serde rename = source name unless the source has its own rename), and multipart DTOs pin the source serde rename as the form field name (form_data field_name > serde rename > rename_all)
